name: The University of Texas at San Antonio

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - The University of Texas at San Antonio (expenses)

stats.notes: Common Data Set 2024-2025 (fall 2024 first-years), the newest one listed on UTSA's Institutional Research page (a 2025-26 file was not available). 25,422 applicants, 22,063 admitted, 5,980 enrolled. International admit rate 96.5% (442 of 458), 104 enrolled. UTSA did not report a high school GPA, so GPA figures are not shown; 16% of enrollees were in the top tenth and 55% in the top quarter of their class. Undergraduate enrollment is 31,127 (total undergraduates); 427 is degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates. Student-faculty ratio 23.8 is from the Common Data Set (fall 2024).

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-25: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: IPEDS College Navigator 2024-25 first-time undergraduate expenses: tuition amounts include required fees; on-campus food and housing $14,912. The Common Data Set did not report costs. From the Common Data Set 2024-25: 340 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (avg $6,646, total $2,259,506); it did not mark whether the aid was need- or non-need-based
